generations.name: Third generation (U25)
generations.notes: First electric Countryman (built in Leipzig). SE ALL4: 66.5 kWh gross / about 64.6 kWh usable, up to 130 kW DC, 11 kW AC. Only the SE ALL4 is rated in both regulators; the FWD Countryman E is not sold here. Confidence: medium-high (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mini_Countryman
